# Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Urban Craft & Co.

## Ordering & Minimums

### What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?

Our standard MOQ starts from 25–50 units for customized corporate gift sets and drinkware. For select premium leather goods, lower quantities can be accommodated.

### Can we see physical samples before placing a bulk order?

Yes, we provide blank or branded pre-production samples so your team can evaluate finish, material quality, and packaging prior to mass production.

## Branding & Customization

### What branding methods do you offer?

We offer laser engraving, UV full-color flatbed printing, blind debossing/embossing, screen printing, and custom foil-stamped presentation boxes.

### Can we customize individual names on the gifts?

Yes, laser engraving allows individual recipient names or employee IDs on each pen, bottle, or notebook in the set.

## Dispatch & Delivery

### How long does delivery take?

Standard production is 3–7 business days following digital artwork approval. Pan-India courier transit takes 2–4 business days. Express turnaround is available for urgent events.

### Do you handle dropshipping directly to employee addresses?

Yes, we can manage direct-to-home dropshipping across India with tracking links shared for each package.
